item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 05/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Koinu will skirt the southern part of Taiwan and move towards the coastal waters of eastern Guangdong today. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather will remain very hot over the coast of southern China. Koinu will edge closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, under the influence of the northeast monsoon, Koinu will weaken gradually. Under the influence of Koinu's rainbands and the monsoon, it will be windier with showers over the coastal areas of Guangdong during the weekend. The weather will be appreciably cooler. The northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China early to midweek next week.
